label: Q-03
title: approvedMinters() copies the whole EnumerableSet to memory with no bound
fingerprintNote: sha256(contract:function:rootCauseClass)[:16] - legacy form, empty entryPoint. Carried verbatim from sanitized.json; reproduces from fingerprintBasis.

attackPath: EnumerableSet.values() is unbounded; an off-chain reader gas-outs once the set grows, and any future on-chain consumer inherits the unbounded loop.

justification: QA. The C4 'unused view functions are QA at best' rule applies as a severity CEILING and the finding was already filed at that ceiling, so the rule changes nothing here. External view only; no on-chain caller is forced through it.
recommendation: Paginate, or keep approvedMinterAt/approvedMinterCount (:169, :164) as the supported iteration path and document values() as off-chain-only.
